topic: remove rust from golf club heads
core_question: How do you clean rust off the head of a golf club, like an iron? (secondary: How do I fix a showerhead that has weak, sputtering water pressure?)
answer_summary: Soak the clubhead in white vinegar for a short time to loosen rust, then scrub with fine steel wool or a rust eraser, rinse, dry thoroughly, and apply a light coat of oil to prevent recurrence.; after the topic shift: Remove the showerhead (or leave it attached in a bag), soak it in white vinegar for an hour or more to dissolve mineral/limescale deposits clogging the nozzle holes, then scrub and rinse.
